2609.00453.title: mimeo: Compiling Public Expert Corpora into Agent Skills and Testing What Transfers
2609.00453.paper_summary: Giving an agent a file about a named expert can supply hard-to-find material, produce a recognizable persona, or change what the agent decides. These are different claims. We test each one. mimeo is an open-source tool that finds a person's public work, checks each extracted quotation against the cached source text, and writes a file an agent can load. Eight logged builds averaged 38 model calls; the check rejects 13.2% of extracted quotations. We tested four expert files with one coding-agent harness. Knowledge access was clearest: mimeo answered all 20 obscure, quotation-heavy questions; no closed-book condition answered more than 10. Keyword search (BM25) over the same pages answered 15-17, a gap this sample cannot resolve. Grounding showed one clear benefit: personas written from model memory misstated a documented position on 1-4 of 20 answers under every grader; the plain agent and mimeo never did. Every persona was easy to spot on short open prompts, and adding task material lowered identification by 18-23 points. mimeo was no more identifiable than a from-memory profile. Judgment transfer remained unresolved because both tests hit their ceiling: every condition found 94-97% of the problems planted in engineering tasks and scored 94-100% on 16 new application scenarios. An AI-judged "sounds like the expert" score changed with the judge: two of four preferred answers based on a model's stereotype, while two found no difference on the same text. That is a caution against relying on a single AI judge. The evidence supports mimeo as a compact, inspectable reference on a person, not as a demonstrated transfer of their judgment. Toolkit and expert profiles: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo
2609.00453.paper_summary_zh: 給予代理人一份關於某位專家的檔案可以提供難以找到的資料、產生可辨識的人物形象，或改變代理人的決策。這些是不同的主張。我們對每一項進行測試。mimeo 是一個開源工具，可以找到一個人的公開作品，檢查每個提取的引用與快取的源文本，並寫入一個代理人可以加載的檔案。八個登錄的構建平均進行了 38 次模型調用；檢查拒絕了 13.2% 的提取引用。我們用一個編碼代理人工具測試了四個專家檔案。知識獲取最為明確：mimeo 回答了所有 20 個晦澀且引用繁重的問題；沒有任何閉卷條件的回答超過 10 個。對同一頁面的關鍵字搜索（BM25）回答了 15-17 個問題，這個樣本無法解決的差距。基礎顯示出一個明顯的好處：從模型記憶中撰寫的人物形象在每個評分者的 20 個答案中錯誤陳述了 1-4 個已記錄的立場；而普通代理人和 mimeo 從未如此。每個人物形象在短的開放提示中都很容易被辨識，並且添加任務材料使識別率降低了 18-23 分。mimeo 的可識別性並不比從記憶中生成的檔案更高。判斷轉移仍未解決，因為兩個測試都達到了其上限：每個條件都找到了 94-97% 的工程任務中植入的問題，並在 16 個新的應用場景中得分 94-100%。由 AI 判斷的「聽起來像專家」的分數隨著評判者的不同而改變：四個中有兩個根據模型的刻板印象偏好答案，而另外兩個在相同文本上沒有發現差異。這對依賴單一 AI 評判者提出了警告。證據支持 mimeo 作為一個緊湊、可檢查的個人參考，而不是作為其判斷的實證轉移。工具包和專家檔案：https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo
